title: cost --rework reads zero for a sprint whose orchestrator session is still open, because the work sidecar is read only from closed sessions, so the review and the retrospective have no figures
goal: backlog.py cost --rework SP, run inside the orchestrator session that is still open, reports the prompts and tokens of the items' work windows from the open session's spool (marked as an open-session figure) or says plainly that the figures wait for the session's end, so a review and a retrospective that run in the same session are not shown all zeros as if no work happened; a test named cost_open_session_figures plants an open session with work rows and sees them or the stated wait. Evidence: cost --rework SP-tt4tibyn and SP-itmjxudu printed 0 prompts and 0 tokens while the orchestrator session was open (kb/_self/querylog.md, The work sidecar: read from closed sessions, never an open one; ql_distill.SESSION_IDLE_CLOSED_S 86400); found by the SP-tt4tibyn review.
repro_reason: the zero figure needs an open orchestrator session with work rows, which only the new test can plant; the text match fails while the doc says the open session is never read and passes once that sentence is replaced

gates.question: Which behaviour does cost --rework take for a sprint whose session is still open?
